visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back in a ponytail wearing a white t-shirt stands in a bright room. Behind her, wall-mounted clear display cases are filled with various plush toys, and a monitor shows a pink cartoon character. She holds a large, empty clear display case toward the camera with an excited facial expression. (2) The woman stands on a chair and physically removes the existing smaller cases from the white wall. (3) A close-up shot shows the white wall with adhesive residue and damage. Hands hold a white plastic bottle and a yellow sponge, applying a white liquid substance to patch and clean the wall surface. (4) The woman mounts three larger, three-tiered clear display cases onto the wall above her desk. She begins placing small cat-like plush toys into the individual compartments of the cases. (5) She stands before the now-partially filled cases, gesturing with her hands. She then holds up several new plush toys still in their plastic packaging, presenting them one by one to the lens with close-up shots. (6) The woman finishes arranging the plushies. The camera pans across three fully stocked cases. She gives a thumbs-up to the camera. A digital screenshot of a social media post from 'Threads' is overlaid on the screen.
